output.brief:
The 26-point gap on the dashboard mostly reflects who joined Bridge Hours, not what the tutoring did. Participants were already much weaker in September: 91% scored below the 40th percentile, against 12% of non-participants. When the research office compared students with similar fall scores, the winter results were nearly identical. Participants gained slightly more in one band and slightly less in another, and the design cannot detect a small effect either way. I am fairly confident the raw gap is not evidence that the program lowers scores. I am not confident the program helps, and the Stepwise fraction methods that teachers flagged are unchecked.
Next steps: do not vote to end or expand on this data. Ask the research office for the comparison of students just either side of the 196 cut, promised by 27 Feb, and present that to the board in place of the raw chart. Have the math coordinator review Stepwise fraction lessons and observe sessions. Keep the referral list for now so the comparison stays valid.
output.methodChoice: Collected X8 and X1 only, then stopped; further evidence was unlikely to change the answers.
